exposure: Hospital Information System (HIS)-based psychological nursing intervention models (including systematic psychological assessment, individualized counseling sessions, structured education, and continuous perioperative support)
outcome: maternal depression scores (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale)
cohort: The study included 568 cesarean section patients (284 control group receiving standard care, 284 intervention group receiving HIS-based psychological nursing) from Foshan Women and Children Hospital between January 2022 and December 2023.
finding: HIS-based psychological nursing intervention models were associated with significant improvements in maternal psychological well-being, clinical outcomes (reduced operative duration, blood loss, and hospital stays), and neonatal health indicators (higher 5-minute Apgar scores and reduced asphyxia rates).
